title: A Stable and General Quantum Fractional-Step Lattice Boltzmann Method for Incompressible Flows
summary: Quantum computing shows substantial potential in accelerating simulations and alleviating memory bottlenecks in computational fluid dynamics (CFD), owing to its inherent properties of superposition and entanglement. The lattice Boltzmann method (LBM), being largely algebraic in nature, has inspired the development of various quantum LBMs. However, most existing approaches fix the relaxation time at $τ$ = 1, thereby confining a given mesh resolution to simulations at a single Reynolds number.
